verdict.rationale: vLLM ships as an installable Python package (uv/pip) with an offline-inference mode, so developers can build against it directly. Its drop-in OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages, and gRPC APIs also let them reuse existing client libraries. However, those client SDKs are third-party, not vLLM's own, and the evidence never documents a dedicated official client SDK or its API surface. missing for 10: documented official client SDK(s) across languages, SDK API reference evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK-based building.
